facts.statement: Reused current native v35 direct CP input/output,19 no-query global-cache patterns and v27 distinct stream overlaps. New finite role/optional-plane/stream-publish guards do not replace those execution counts or create another functional resource bucket.

Global metadata resolver visits only four role-specific cache planes, avoiding unrelated native draft entries. CP non-index-source returns indices for local qr rows; base returns its local _indexer_hidden_states rows. Matching full hidden batch size is not the query row contract.

Index query preparation retains qr projection, hidden-state weight projection, RoPE and event join. Query quantization uses a five-term guard; source cache update waits C2 metadata if required, then indexer selection waits actual quantize_done.

Legacy select_projected early no-cache branch fills the provided indices bank -1, zeroes topk_lengths and candidate-source lengths, and creates -1 candidate blocks. Its nonempty fallback already passes indices_output and lengths_output into prepare_indexer_indices; direct output is baseline, not a new unconditional optimization.

Shared state reset returns None without clearing. Source layers must overwrite the active rows before reuse within the forward. Stable addresses are not content-generation equality across iterations or different accepted/rejected histories.

Normal same-config construction allocates topk bank [max_tokens,config.index_topk] INT32 and wires it into every layer shared state; topology.index_topk=int(config.index_topk). A leading row slice is contiguous at full width. If unchanged, compressed_indices has K==topk, so pad_sparse_indices does not pad, unsqueeze is a view, and contiguous/int may preserve storage. Do not count three hypothetical device kernels. This does not attest arbitrary post-construction replacement/capture banks.

Existing quantization sharing is guarded by metadata identity plus quant-method type/communication flags. Partial local-query/global-cache reuse would require row-equivalent quantization with identical scale/parameter/communication semantics and an exact row map; source method type equality alone is not proof. Current positive Q_A/KV primitives are unquantized F.linear; no actual quantize-kernel savings are counted.

Packed prefill/mixed SWA cache write is on main after stream join; other selected cases write on aux before join. Norm/RoPE/output/cache events must preserve exactly one publication and previously observed overlaps. A reduction in launches does not prove lower request latency.
